_comment: human-review.json for a Ludvig Python/Serverless service (shaped on activities-backend). Copy it to the repository root as human-review.json and adjust. Every step not named here either needs nothing (logging, complexity, tests, owners) or is postponed in the Ludvig fork (video, city, dsaudit).

ci._comment: CircleCI reports to GitHub as commit statuses; name the jobs that prove the build. Never pushes unless push is true.

logging._comment: Optional: the folders scanned. Default: src, lambdas, backend, src_py — whichever exist.

sequence._comment: Draws the tests this branch wrote or edited (and any marked @pytest.mark.genseq) as call sequences, with the skill's hr_genseq pytest plugin — the step puts it on PYTHONPATH.

commands.run: HR_GENSEQ_SELECT={tests.pytest} pipenv run python -m pytest -p hr_genseq -q -p no:cacheprovider
